```markdown
# API Documentation: URL Preview Endpoint

## GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/preview

Returns cached title and description metadata for the target URL associated with a short code. On a cache miss the service fetches the target page, extracts metadata from the HTML `<head>`, stores the result in Redis, and returns it. If a stale cached entry exists when a live fetch fails, the stale entry is returned rather than a 503 ("stale-while-revalidate" semantics).

### Path Parameters

| Name   | In   | Required | Type   | Description                     | Example |
|--------|------|----------|--------|---------------------------------|---------|
| `code` | path | Yes      | string | The short code to look up       | `aB3xQ` |

### Request

No request body. No query parameters.

### Responses

#### 200 OK

Preview metadata was successfully retrieved (from cache or by live fetch). The `title` and `description` fields may be `null` if the target page did not include those elements.

**Content-Type:** `application/json`

```json
{
  "shortCode": "aB3xQ",
  "targetUrl": "https://example.com/some/article",
  "title": "Example Domain",
  "description": "An example article about something",
  "fetchedAt": "2024-05-01T12:00:00Z",
  "cacheExpiresAt": "2024-05-02T12:00:00Z"
}
```

**Response schema:**

| Field           | Type              | Required | Description                                              |
|-----------------|-------------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `shortCode`     | string            | Yes      | The requested short code                                 |
| `targetUrl`     | string (URI)      | Yes      | The resolved target URL                                  |
| `title`         | string \| null    | No       | Contents of the `<title>` tag on the target page         |
| `description`   | string \| null    | No       | Contents of `<meta name="description">` on target page   |
| `fetchedAt`     | string (ISO-8601) | Yes      | Timestamp when the metadata was fetched                  |
| `cacheExpiresAt`| string (ISO-8601) | Yes      | Timestamp when the cached entry expires                  |

#### 404 Not Found

The given short code does not exist in the system.

**Content-Type:** `application/json`

```json
{
  "error": "Short code 'aB3xQ' not found"
}
```

| Field   | Type   | Description               |
|---------|--------|---------------------------|
| `error` | string | Human-readable error message |

#### 503 Service Unavailable

The external fetch of the target URL timed out or failed, and no cached (including stale) preview is available.

**Content-Type:** `application/json`

```json
{
  "error": "Preview unavailable: upstream fetch timed out",
  "retryAfter": 30
}
```

| Field        | Type    | Description                                    |
|--------------|---------|------------------------------------------------|
| `error`      | string  | Human-readable error message                   |
| `retryAfter` | integer | Suggested number of seconds to wait before retrying |

### Caching Behaviour

- Cache backend: Redis (key schema `preview:{code}`), with an in-process fallback.
- Default TTL: 86 400 seconds (24 hours), configurable via `PreviewConfig.cacheTtlSeconds`.
- First write uses `SET NX` to prevent cache stampedes under concurrent requests for the same code.
- If the Redis entry is stale but still present at fetch time, the stale document is returned with a 200 rather than a 503.

### Timeout Configuration (`PreviewConfig`)

| Property           | Default  | Description                                              |
|--------------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `fetchTimeoutMs`   | 3000 ms  | Maximum time allowed for the external HTTP fetch         |
| `cacheTimeoutMs`   | 3000 ms  | Maximum time allowed for a cache read/write operation    |
| `cacheTtlSeconds`  | 86400 s  | TTL applied to each stored `PreviewDocument` in Redis    |
| `maxRedirects`     | 5        | Maximum number of HTTP redirects `MetadataFetcher` follows |

`MetadataFetcher` streams only the `<head>` section of the target HTML document (aborts after `</head>`) to minimise bandwidth consumption.
```

```markdown
## Changelog

### Added — URL Preview endpoint (`GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/preview`)

Introduced a new preview feature that returns the `<title>` and `<meta name="description">` metadata for the target URL of any short code; results are cached in Redis with a configurable TTL (default 24 h) using cache-aside semantics, and the external fetch is bounded by a configurable timeout (default 3 s) to keep response latency predictable even when target sites are slow or unreachable.
```
